missing_evidence: Order-service logs/traces showing the internal cause of its 500 (exception, stack trace)
Order-service dependency health (inventory, payment, postgresql) to rule out downstream origin
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and gateway logs show the 500 originating at the order service (server.address=order), so the checkout 502s are a downstream propagation of an order-service server error.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service is not established; only the 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order-service 500s on POST /v1/orders across all four traces and matching gateway logs; topology confirms gateway->order. The order service is the failing hop, but its internal fault is not yet observed, so the bounded candidate is http-500 at order with downstream dependencies unverified.
